provides: Delivery methods (courier, pickup point, digital), zones matched by country / region / postcode prefix, rates (flat, free above a subtotal, per kilogram when cart lines carry attrs.weight_grams), pickup points with hours and coordinates, a per-user address book with one default, and shipments with a table FSM (pending, packed, shipped, delivered, returned, cancelled), a timeline, tracking number and link. It is the stapel-orders shipping adjuster (delivery.quote, kind shipping, order 200; honours a promotion's meta.free_shipping marker) and a checkout hook (delivery.reserve keeps the validated choice and the address snapshot under the checkout attempt key; commit creates the order's shipment; release on cancel cancels it). Carriers are a strategy registry: manual by default, an auto-advancing mock for prototypes, a documented Carrier ABC for real ones.

gates.behavior: true: delivery.quote answers error.400.delivery_method_required when context.delivery is missing; false: it answers no adjustment.

curated.summary: true (default): a checkout without a delivery choice is refused with error.400.delivery_method_required (unless nothing in the cart ships). false: such a checkout simply has no shipping line and no shipment. Values: true, false.

gates.behavior: manual: shipments move only by staff (or a carrier webhook); mock: the beat advances pending -> packed -> shipped -> delivered every MOCK_STEP_MINUTES (system check E002 outside the prototype posture stage).

curated.summary: manual (default): staff record the tracking number and move each shipment. mock: shipments advance to delivered by themselves every few minutes, for demos and prototypes only. A real carrier registers its own name. Values: manual, mock.

extension_points.name: CARRIERS
extension_points.summary: Carrier strategies by slug: {slug: 'dotted.path.Carrier' | None} merged over the built-ins manual and mock (or register_carrier at runtime). A Carrier registers a parcel (tracking number), polls status updates from the beat and renders a tracking link; a push-style carrier's webhook calls services.shipments.apply_carrier_update.

extension_points.name: DEFAULT_CARRIER
extension_points.summary: The carrier a method without its own carrier uses: manual (default), mock (prototype posture only, check E002/W002) or a registered slug / dotted path.

extension_points.name: GEOCODE_FUNCTION
extension_points.summary: A comm Function with the geo.geocode contract that fills missing coordinates of a saved address after commit, best-effort; empty = off.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_DELIVERY_ADDRESS_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_METHOD_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_OPTIONS_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_PICKUP_POINT_PRESENTER / STAPEL_DELIVERY_SHIPMENT_PRESENTER
extension_points.summary: Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for every response presenter, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.

extension_points.name: delivery.quote
extension_points.summary: The orders shipping adjuster: reads context.delivery {method, address | address_id | pickup_point}, answers one shipping adjustment (0.00 when free) or a refusal error key; no personal data in meta.

extension_points.name: delivery.reserve / delivery.commit / delivery.release
extension_points.summary: The orders checkout hook: reserve stores the choice and the address snapshot under the attempt key; commit binds it to the order and creates the shipment; release drops it, or on an order cancel cancels a shipment that has not left. Idempotent on the attempt key.

extension_points.name: delivery.options
extension_points.summary: Every enabled method with its price for a cart and a destination (country is enough), with the reason a method is not offered.

extension_points.name: delivery.shipment.status
extension_points.summary: A shipment's status and tracking for another service, by order_id or shipment_id; no recipient fields.

extension_points.name: delivery.shipment.created
extension_points.summary: A placed order got its shipment: ids, method, carrier, status, shipping amount; never the recipient.

extension_points.name: delivery.shipment.status_changed
extension_points.summary: Every shipment move with the actor (staff, carrier, system) and the tracking number; feeds the buyer notification.

extension_points.name: orders.order.placed
extension_points.summary: Consumed: creates the order's shipment from the checkout intent when the commit hook has not already done it.

extension_points.name: orders.order.status_changed
extension_points.summary: Consumed: an order moved to cancelled cancels its pending or packed shipment.

surface.name: carrier_by_slug
surface.intent: A shipment's carrier for polling and links; an unregistered slug falls back to manual instead of failing the beat.

surface.name: carrier_for_method
surface.intent: A method's own carrier, or the default — what a new shipment of that method gets.

surface.name: carrier_names
surface.intent: The slugs a method and DEFAULT_CARRIER accept (built-ins <- settings <- runtime); also the environment vocabulary.

surface.name: default_carrier
surface.intent: The carrier this deployment uses for methods without their own (delivery_settings.DEFAULT_CARRIER).

surface.name: get_carrier
surface.intent: The carrier registered under a slug; ImproperlyConfigured when unknown.

surface.name: register_carrier
surface.intent: Register (or with None remove) a carrier class under a slug from an AppConfig.ready(); methods and DEFAULT_CARRIER may then name it. The settings twin is STAPEL_DELIVERY['CARRIERS'].

surface.name: reset_carriers
surface.intent: Drop runtime carrier registrations — a test lever.

surface.name: resolve_carrier
surface.intent: Turn a DEFAULT_CARRIER value (slug or dotted path) into a carrier; the AppSettings resolver for the key.

surface.name: uses_mock
surface.intent: Where the mock carrier is in use (DEFAULT_CARRIER, and with methods=True the method codes); what the posture checks E002/W002 read.

requires.reason: comm bus (delivery.* Functions and emits, orders.* and user.merged consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, posture stage, AppSettings

calls delivery.quote as its shipping adjuster and delivery.reserve/commit/release as a checkout hook (preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS), and emits orders.order.placed / status_changed that create and cancel shipments
addresses and shipments are keyed on request.user; user.merged moves a guest's book and shipments to the account on sign-in
GEOCODE_FUNCTION = 'geo.geocode' fills coordinates of saved addresses, by Function name only
a free-shipping promotion marks its adjustment meta.free_shipping, which delivery.quote honours
